def transform(grid):
    g = np.array(grid)
    bg = background(g)
    ys, xs = np.where(g != bg)
    shape = g[ys.min():ys.max() + 1, xs.min():xs.max() + 1]
    H, W = shape.shape
    S = 2 * W + H
    out = np.full((S, S), bg, dtype=g.dtype)
    emit(out, f"Allocate a {S}x{S} canvas: two shape widths ({W}) plus the shape height ({H}) in each direction.")

    # left copy: original motif, tip pointing left
    out[W:W + H, 0:W] = shape
    emit(out, "Stamp the original motif on the left, its blunt end touching the central square.")

    # top copy: rotated clockwise so the tip points up
    out[0:W, W:W + H] = np.rot90(shape, k=-1)
    emit(out, "Stamp the motif rotated 90 degrees clockwise on top, tip pointing up.")

    # right copy: mirrored so the tip points right
    out[W:W + H, W + H:S] = shape[:, ::-1]
    emit(out, "Stamp the left-right mirrored motif on the right, tip pointing right.")

    # bottom copy: rotated counter-clockwise so the tip points down
    out[W + H:S, W:W + H] = np.rot90(shape, k=1)
    emit(out, "Stamp the motif rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise at the bottom; the centre stays empty.")
    return out
